1. Tare the force sensor with the probe in free air above the platen.

args.command:
python3 << 'PY'
import workcell

def fit(pts):
    n = len(pts)
    sx = sum(p[0] for p in pts)
    sy = sum(p[1] for p in pts)
    sxx = sum(p[0]**2 for p in pts)
    sxy = sum(p[0]*p[1] for p in pts)
    b = (n*sxy - sx*sy) / (n*sxx - sx*sx)
    a = (sy - b*sx)/n
    resid = [p[1] - (a + b*p[0]) for p in pts]
    rmse = (sum(r*r for r in resid)/n)**0.5
    return a, b, rmse

# safe move up then to center
r = workcell.call("arm", "move", "520", "-16", "150")
print(r.text.strip())
r = workcell.call("arm", "move", "520", "-40", "140")
print(r.text.strip())
r = workcell.call("ft", "zero")
print(r.text.strip())
r = workcell.call("ft", "read", "300")
print("tare check", r.text.strip())

# descend to near platen
r = workcell.call("arm", "move", "520", "-40", "114")
print(r.text.strip())

# approach in 0.2 mm
contact_z = None
for i in range(30):
    r = workcell.call("arm", "step", "-0.2")
    z, fz = r.data["z_mm"], r.data["fz_N"]
    print(f"approach z={z:.3f} Fz={fz:+.3f}")
    if fz > 0.35:
        contact_z = z
        break

# back off 0.3 to just above, then start series from light contact
r = workcell.call("arm", "step", "0.4")
print("backoff", r.text.strip())

pts_load = []
# compress in 0.8 mm commanded steps until Fz > 40 or 12 steps
for i in range(14):
    r = workcell.call("arm", "step", "-0.8")
    if not r.ok:
        print("FAIL", r.text)
        break
    ft = workcell.call("ft", "read", "400")
    st = workcell.call("arm", "status")
    z = st.data["tip_mm"][2]
    fz = ft.data["fz"]
    fx = ft.data["fx"]
    pts_load.append((z, fz, fx))
    print(f"LOAD z={z:.4f} Fz={fz:.4f} Fx={fx:.3f}")
    if fz > 42:
        break

pts_unload = []
for i in range(len(pts_load)+2):
    r = workcell.call("arm", "step", "0.8")
    if not r.ok:
        print("FAIL", r.text)
        break
    ft = workcell.call("ft", "read", "400")
    st = workcell.call("arm", "status")
    z = st.data["tip_mm"][2]
    fz = ft.data["fz"]
    pts_unload.append((z, fz))
    print(f"UNLOAD z={z:.4f} Fz={fz:.4f}")
    if fz < 0.3:
        break

c = 0.00817
print("\n=== FITS ===")
for name, pts in [("load", [(p[0], p[1]) for p in pts_load]), ("unload", pts_unload)]:
    # drop points with Fz < 1.0 as seating
    good = [p for p in pts if p[1] >= 1.0]
    if len(good) < 4:
        print(name, "too few", pts)
        continue
    a, b, rmse = fit(good)
    kf = -b
    k = 1/(1/kf - c)
    print(f"{name}: n={len(good)} k_fit={kf:.4f} k={k:.4f} rmse={rmse:.4f} a={a:.2f}")

# combined
allpts = [(p[0], p[1]) for p in pts_load if p[1] >= 1] + [p for p in pts_unload if p[1] >= 1]
a, b, rmse = fit(allpts)
kf = -b
k = 1/(1/kf - c)
print(f"combined: n={len(allpts)} k_fit={kf:.4f} k={k:.4f} rmse={rmse:.4f}")
PY
